title: Retraining Experiment Design
objective: Test whether adding targeted independent sessions improves generalization, measured on the frozen Experiment 1 test set and a new held-out evaluation set.

evidence_summary.H1_stringing_clustered: 20122022 date-cluster has fnr_mean=0.20 vs near-zero elsewhere. Stringing performance is not uniform across sessions.
evidence_summary.H2_catastrophic_test_ood: Test recording 15.02.2023_13_19_52 (fnr=0.898) is from a distinct session than any training stringing recording on that date.
evidence_summary.H3_dark_not_fp_driver: Contradicted. Dark bucket has lowest FPR (0.003). Brightness-FPR correlation r=0.22 (weak positive).
evidence_summary.H4_no_darkness_fnr_gradient: Contradicted. Medium bucket FPR 0.055, bright 0.033, dark 0.003.
evidence_summary.H5_under_extrusion_control_ok: Partially supported. 49 recordings/15 dates/fnr_mean=0.05, but two catastrophic sub-sessions exist.

data_requirements.principle: INDEPENDENT SESSIONS, not raw frame count. Each session = a distinct print job, ideally a different date. Session atomicity preserved: never split frames of one session across sets.

priorities.rationale: Primary failure mode. Clustered by date/session. Stage 8 stringing FNR=0.213 on frozen test.
diversity: Different print stages where stringing occurs
Mix of severe and mild stringing
Dates not already in training set
priorities.held_out: Hold out 1-2 sessions from a distinct date range or object as the new held-out evaluation set.

priorities.rationale: Dark-normal FPR is currently low (0.003) but coverage is narrow. The known FP test recording (brightness ~76) may represent an uncovered condition.
Only 5 training recordings (191 frames), 0 test frames. Cannot measure frozen-test spaghetti performance.
Already well-represented (37 train recordings). Maintain or modestly extend.

data_requirements.labeling_requirements: Same binary normal/failing + fine failure type as existing. Metadata: date, object, lighting condition, camera settings.

split_strategy.held_out_set: Sessions from new data held out at acquisition time. This becomes the second evaluation set to measure improvement.
split_strategy.frozen_test_set: The existing Experiment 1 test set remains FROZEN. Used only for final comparison.
split_strategy.existing_data: All existing train/val recordings remain in their current splits. New data is ADDED to the existing train/val pools.
split_strategy.directory_structure:
New sessions follow the existing layout:
  datasets/processed/printing-errors/{failing,normal}/Recording_<date>_<time>/frame.png
split_strategy.csv_update: New rows appended to train.csv and val.csv. splits.json updated with new counts. metadata.csv updated with new fine-class mappings.

frozen_test_eval.description: Run Stage 8 evaluation pipeline on the frozen Experiment 1 test set with the new checkpoint.

held_out_eval.description: Evaluate on the new held-out evaluation set (sessions held out from new data acquisitions).

train_cache_rebuild.description: Rebuild frozen_train_trajectories.json with the new checkpoint for Stage 10-style analysis.

stage10_rerun.description: Re-run Stage 10 cluster/domain audit with new train cache to verify stringing cluster FNR improved.

threshold_sweep.description: Run Stage 8 threshold sweep on val split to confirm 0.65 remains optimal or select new threshold.

runtime_estimates.note: All estimates based on measured runtimes on Apple M1 Pro (MPS). CPU will be ~2-3x slower. Scaling is roughly linear with frame count.

measured baselines.experiment_1_training: 968s (11254 train frames, 30 epochs, early stop at ~20)

total_wall_time_with_data_prep.note: Data preparation (organizing new sessions into directory layout, labeling, updating CSVs) is NOT included in the above estimates. This is the dominant time cost and depends on data availability.

minimum.description: Stringing FNR on frozen test improves by >=5pp (from 0.213 to <=0.163), without F1 regression.

meaningful.description: Stringing FNR improves by >=10pp AND overall F1 improves by >=1pp on frozen test.

strong.description: Stringing FNR on frozen test approaches under-extrusion FNR (currently 0.155), and held-out set shows comparable performance.

abort_criteria.description: If F1 on frozen test regresses by >2pp, or if any failure type FNR increases by >5pp, the experiment is a regression.

minimum_acquisition.minimum_not_met: Analyze which failure type regressed. Consider: (a) more data of the failing type, (b) different augmentation, (c) learning rate adjustment

strong_acquisition.meaningful_met: Proceed to ideal acquisition or deployment planning
strong_acquisition.meaningful_not_met: Evaluate whether the bottleneck is data diversity or model capacity. Consider: (a) architecture search, (b) different pretrained backbone, (c) more targeted data

ideal_acquisition.strong_not_met: Model capacity may be the limiting factor. Consider: (a) larger ShuffleNet, (b) MobileNetV3, (c) EfficientNet-B0

gating_checklist.description: All items must be checked before executing the experiment.

items.check: Data organized in existing directory layout
metadata.csv updated with new fine-class mappings
items.required: All new frames have fine class (normal/under_extrusion/stringing/spaghetti)

items.check: Training pipeline tested on small subset
items.required: Verify no crashes, correct class mapping

limitations: Runtime estimates assume MPS; CPU will be ~2-3x slower.
Data preparation time is not included in pipeline estimates.
Success criteria assume the bottleneck is data diversity, not model capacity.
The frozen test set is a single snapshot; held-out set provides a second signal.
No claims of real-world generalization are made.
Session atomicity means some useful within-session frames may be lost at split boundaries.
